home.metaTitle: Example Company: consulting, training and support for small businesses
home.metaDescription: A fictional company that helps small businesses with planning, training and everyday support. This is a demo site with made-up content.
home.heroTitle: We help your small business grow in clear steps
home.heroText: Short consulting sessions, hands-on training and daily support. We explain everything in plain words and work with you step by step.
home.servicesLead: Three services that cover most of what a small business needs at the start.
home.service1Text: Short sessions where we review your business and leave you with a clear written plan.
home.service2Text: Practical courses for your team, using examples from your own work, not from textbooks.
home.service3Text: A team that answers your everyday questions and follows up after the project ends.
home.ctaTitle: Have a question or an idea?
home.ctaText: Send us a short message and we will reply within one working day.
